details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install path (__dirname), the current working directory, the npm/node user agent and the protocol, plus an X-Beacon-Package header. The same beacon also fires when the package's index.js is required, which exports a no-op Proxy so that builds importing the name complete instead of crashing. The beacon collects only host and install metadata: it reads no environment variables, tokens, credential files or file contents, and contacts no other destination. The README states the package was published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and that it only reports that it was installed. This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs host metadata — package name, os.hostname(), install directory, working directory, npm/node user agent — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted.
